source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide which main cell part explains a job: cell membrane, cytoplasm, or nucleus.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

intelligence.enrichment: Cells have three main parts: the cell membrane, cytoplasm, and nucleus. The cell membrane encloses the cytoplasm and nucleus, separates cells, and allows useful materials in and wastes out; the cytoplasm contains cell components and many life processes occur there; the nucleus regulates cell activities and growth. Cell part identity -> specific role in boundary control, life processes, or regulation. The learner correctly applies this rule: Cells have three main parts: the cell membrane, cytoplasm, and nucleus. The cell membrane encloses the cytoplasm and nucleus, separates cells, and allows useful materials in and wastes out; the cytoplasm contains cell components and many life processes occur there; the nucleus regulates cell activities and growth. The nucleus is the important part, so it does every major job inside the cell.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Microorganisms: friend and foe. The student must decide: Decide which main cell part explains a job: cell membrane, cytoplasm, or nucleus. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
